department: Geology Program, School of Earth Systems and Sustainability

deadline.value: The catalog gives no application deadline for the Geosciences PhD.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional and can be sent to the Geology Program.
gre_general.quote: GRE test scores are optional and can be sent directly to the Geology Program

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Research assistantships usually come from individual faculty grants, so funding is not guaranteed.
funding.quote: Research assistantships are usually available only from research grants of individual faculty members

entry_route.value: The catalog expects about two years beyond a master's degree.
entry_route.quote: Ordinarily, the doctoral student should expect to spend a minimum of two years beyond the Master’s degree, or its equivalent, in residence

notes: The Geosciences PhD is the earth-sciences PhD. The catalog also says students may take an interdisciplinary PhD in Environmental Resources and Policy, which has its own record.
name: Ph.D. in Geosciences
